# Publish gate report

**Going out:** Search ad (headline plus description), UK audience. No send time was given.

**Claims:** All pass.
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Monthly loose leaf tea | Product fact, fine as written |
| Subscribers can pause or cancel any time | On the policy list |
| Free UK delivery on orders over £25 | On the policy list, and the £25 condition is stated |

**Regulated claims:** The only relevant area is offers. "Free delivery" carries its condition (over £25), so it is not misleading. There are no health, green, money or urgency claims.

**House style:** The copy is plain and specific. It has no banned words or AI tells, and I made no edits.

**Disclosure:** Search platforms add their own "Ad" label to this format, so nothing is needed in the copy. If this runs on a channel that doesn't label ads automatically, add "Ad" up front.

**Fixed:** Nothing.

**Needs a decision:**
- **Character limits:** If this is for Google Ads, the description is about 102 characters, and the limit is 90. The platform would likely reject it. Suggested trim: "Monthly loose leaf tea. Pause or cancel any time. Free UK delivery over £25." This keeps every claim intact and puts it at about 76 characters. If you use it, it needs a fresh check.
- **Approver:** The policy doesn't name an approver, so I need an explicit yes from you on the exact final wording before it is scheduled or launched. I haven't recorded any approval.
